title: Compile late tasks on the uncertainty support of an exact acquired interval
statement: For the ENTIRE exact symmetric family S in[S_L,S_U], put Sc=(S_L+S_U)/2,D=S_U-S_L>=0,W=ran D and Tprime=(1/2)*D^(1/2)*T*D^(1/2) restricted to W. With freely programmable real noiseless native vector actions, the exact new-call minimum for tr(T*S) is max(n_positive(Tprime),n_negative(Tprime)); Tprime=0 needs zero new calls.

requires: Actual justified endpoints describing the whole compatible symmetric family, with D positive semidefinite and known support.
The query-rank lower/upper equality requires noiseless full-vector responses and arbitrary real inputs; input normalization may use known scaling.
provides: For the ENTIRE exact symmetric family S in[S_L,S_U], put Sc=(S_L+S_U)/2,D=S_U-S_L>=0,W=ran D and Tprime=(1/2)*D^(1/2)*T*D^(1/2) restricted to W. With freely programmable real noiseless native vector actions, the exact new-call minimum for tr(T*S) is max(n_positive(Tprime),n_negative(Tprime)); Tprime=0 needs zero new calls.
assumptions: For an outer or nonconvex correlated posterior, exact query rank and sharpness do not follow. Native noise is changed by support normalization and cannot be copied as an unchanged uniform error.
Physical exactness and the earlier endpoint-acquisition theorem are not acquired just by naming an interval.
costs: Pay endpoint/support construction, square-root arithmetic, input scaling/precision and actual full-vector returns. Known lower-dimensional support saves calls only under its justified exact geometry.
contract.units: D and Sc have source-response units; Tprime carries task variation after the declared support normalization. Noise terms retain native-coordinate units.
contract.obstruction: Establish whole-family equality and the actual instrument before importing the noiseless minimum; retain outer-family certificates separately.

body: The interval is precisely S=Sc+(1/2)D^(1/2)*X*D^(1/2), with symmetric ||X||op<=1 on W and no variation on ker D. Known arithmetic and nonzero scaling convert a noiseless native action into an X-action on W, so the eta=0 signed-inertia result applies. Scaling is not a free noisy oracle transformation. With noisy native reports use Lhat=tr(T*Sc)+sum y_j^T*(z_j-Sc*q_j). Any q_j,y_j then gives the sound bound (1/2)||D^(1/2)*(T-sum sym(q_j*y_j^T))*D^(1/2)||_*+sum eta_j*||y_j||. A containing OUTER interval supports this upper bound, but not the exact-family lower/query theorem or automatic sharpness. Arbitrary old noisy observations need not acquire the entire interval. This batch supplies no general predecessor acquisition proof by implication.
